model: ROLEX Submariner Date 126613LB (41 mm steel and yellow-gold Rolesor, blue dial, blue Cerachrom bezel with gold coin edge, date with Cyclops lens, two-tone Oyster bracelet)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Submariner Date 41 template (126610LN first), this is the 126613LB follower (blue dial, blue ceramic bezel, yellow-gold coin edge / crown / centre links come through the projected photo; hands are re-traced as flat polygons because the hands are gold with white lume and dark facets on a blue dial: measure hands mode shapes): the Submariner 41 geometry (same case, bezel, crown, bracelet and camera as the no-date 124060, whose alpha mask this photo reproduces) plus a Cyclops date lens at 3 o'clock (date section; the outline is the photographed lens). Case and lugs with crown guards from the photo silhouette, ceramic insert + polished rim + fluted coin-edge ring, domed crystal, traced hand outlines, fluted crown and the three-column Oyster bracelet at the photo's joints; dial, indices, print, date window and numeral, bezel numerals / scale / lume pearl and the photographed hands come from one native photo map or the projected steel photo. Native 1920 x 2857 photo, 22.785 px/mm, no texture scaling.

case.note: outline = photo silhouette (lug top y 900 = 23.0 mm, lug bottom y 1988 = 24.75 mm, crown guards to x 1466 = 22.2 mm); the slab slopes toward the bracelet

bezel.note: black ceramic insert (bezel_in 15.67 .. insert_out 19.36 mm), flat polished rim to rim_out 19.72, coin edge (120 flutes) from there to the tips at 20.5 mm sloping down to z_coin_out

hands.note: hands = traced photo outlines (trace.hands[name].outline_mm) as flat polygons; the lume, Mercedes lines and black facets stay in the projected photo

crown.note: fluted Rolex crown (guards are in the case slab): flutes x 1426..1498, cap to 1520, axis 0.53 mm below the pivot

strap.note: strap.bracelet.columns lists the column kinds left to right; bounds_x_mm holds one boundary less; pieces_mm has top / bottom [y0, y1] chains per kind

bracelet.note: Oyster bracelet: brushed outer links and a wider centre link. Joint rows (px, 22.785 px/mm, pivot (960, 1424)): outer top 756.7, ends 675; outer bottom 2181 / 2366 / 2485, end 2525; centre top 864 / 721, end 671; centre bottom 2028 / 2240 / 2409 / 2502, end 2525; column lines x 859 / 1060.5 (top), 858 / 1062 (bottom). Outer link edges come from the alpha silhouette (the bracelet tapers from 20.6 mm at the lugs to about 16 mm at the end).

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass

date.note: Cyclops lens: photographed outline (measure.date.lens_px, 7.3 x 5.8 mm, centre 9.3 mm right of the pivot) as a wall + two bevel rings + flat top above the crystal (the crystal top is 8.68..8.75 there); photo projection, emission = dial; heights are scaled by pose.depth_scale like every part
